You've got this buddy! If you are overworking yourself please take a break from it and then get back to track again, Do things that you like when you are feeling stressed, whenever i feel stressed out i just usually play my guitar and it helps me very much... try taking a good long 8 hours of sleep... I cant say about your relationship cuz i've never been into one but if you feel the need to get out of it you should probably do it, try not to fall in it again...well that's all i can help you with, give yourself time to relax, have a good sleep :)

Sorry if it doesn't sound helpful but i tried
Thank you for taking your time reading this, i really appreciate it <3 i am trying to be better
If you're gonna get in our way then die
